title: Condition (draft)

rise_ft.description: Default vertical leg UP, in feet, every linear run of this condition adds to its plan length (LF = plan + rise + drop). A run may override it with its own rise_ft.

drop_ft.description: Default vertical leg DOWN, in feet, every linear run of this condition adds to its plan length. A run may override it with its own drop_ft.

basis.description: Which of the condition's totals the row divides by per. Writers emit area (the default when absent), linear, count, seam_lf (the figured roll-layout seam length), cables or pulls (the condition's linked cables and pulls from its cable runs, for a condition with a cable_setup; ×N applied, unlinked and held devices excluded). seam_lf, cables and pulls are figured, not measured, and read 0 without a roll_setup or a linked run. The engine reads any other value as area.

cable_setup.description: Division 27 cable opt-in on a count condition (web/src/lib/cable.js): device_type, cables_per_location, cable_type, vertical_ft, loop_device_ft, loop_tr_ft. Presence of a device_type makes the condition a device condition; null or absent opts out.

role.description: "tr" flags a count condition whose markers are telecom rooms (the origins cable runs home to); "route" flags a linear condition whose shapes are cable routes (the ones no linked run uses are reported unlinked). Absent on every other condition.

description: Existing condition configuration, not a computed report or price. Additional setup, variant, style, and material fields remain opaque and preserved in this draft.
